name: knowledge-health
description: Deterministic, zero-LLM store check: stubs, orphans, broken citations, unindexed items, past-expiry probes. Cheap enough to run on every write.

fix_index.help: Re-sync the search index for items found missing from it. Off by default: this template's job is to report, and a check that also writes is no longer an independent check.

metadata.why_free: Zero model calls. Every finding here is a deterministic property of the store, so paying a model to notice a 40-character body would be paying for arithmetic.
metadata.run_before_reason: Linting a stub spends a model call to discover it is a stub, which this pass already knew for free.

steering_examples.description: Check the knowledge store and re-sync anything missing from the search index.
Skip the orphan check this run — I know about those and they're deliberate.
